name: Fresh milk
summary: Fresh milk from the plateau dairy, drunk cold in the farm town.
origin: The Moc Chau dairy farm. The national authority’s attractions feature, and the Tourism Information Technology Center.
howToEat: Drink it cold or as the morning cup in the farm town.
Dat Viet Tour lists a 20,000 VND gate and Kenh Homestay lists 10,000 VND. Both list 08:00–18:00. Neither is the dairy company’s notice.
where: The dairy farm in the farm town. The two write-ups both list 168 Hoàng Quốc Việt and disagree on the gate. Those addresses are not merged into one chosen fee.
seoDescription: Fresh milk from the plateau dairy, drunk cold in the farm town.
